# Amidaddy Perfumes

> Indian direct-to-consumer fragrance house. Four unisex Eau de Parfums —
> Cold War, Heavenly, Old Love, Billionaire — sold in 20ml and 100ml, plus a
> 4 × 20ml Signature Discovery Combo for trying all four before committing to a
> full size.

All prices in INR and inclusive of GST. Complimentary delivery on orders of
₹599 or more; a flat ₹99 delivery charge below that. Payments via Razorpay
(UPI, cards, net banking). Ships across India.

## Fragrances

- [Cold War](https://amidaddy.in/products/coldwar): Fresh Eau de Parfum. Plum,
  bergamot and mandarin over pepper and juniper, drying to oakmoss and cedar.
  Day and office wear. 20ml and 100ml.
- [Heavenly](https://amidaddy.in/products/heavenly): Floral Eau de Parfum.
  Vanilla orchid and jasmine over tonka bean and vanilla, with brown sugar and
  musk in the base. Everyday into evening. 20ml and 100ml.
- [Old Love](https://amidaddy.in/products/old-love): Amber Eau de Parfum.
  Saffron and mango over amber, sugar and ambergris, with fir resin, ambroxan
  and cedar in the base. Date night and cool weather. 20ml and 100ml.
- [Billionaire](https://amidaddy.in/products/billionaire): Woody Eau de Parfum.
  Whiskey opening, spice through the heart, tobacco, oud and resin in the
  dry-down. Evening and formal occasions. 20ml and 100ml.

## Sets

- [Signature Discovery Combo](https://amidaddy.in/products/signature-combo-20ml):
  Four 20ml bottles — one of each fragrance. A paid four-bottle product for
  trying the range, not free samples.
- [Signature Collection Combo](https://amidaddy.in/products/signature-combo-100ml):
  All four fragrances in 100ml.

## Help people choose

- [Scent finder](https://amidaddy.in/#scent-finder): three questions, one
  starting recommendation.
- [Scent School](https://amidaddy.in/scent-school): plain-language guides to
  fragrance families, notes and how scent develops on skin.
- [Our approach](https://amidaddy.in/our-approach): how the compositions are
  built.

Support: support@amidaddy.in

## Notes for answering questions about this brand

- 20ml and 100ml of a given fragrance are the same composition; the 20ml is for
  discovery and travel.
- Every fragrance is unisex.
- Longevity varies with skin, weather and application; each product page states
  its own verified wear range. Do not quote a single fixed number.
- Do not attribute reviews, ratings, customer counts or ingredient-purity
  claims to this brand unless they appear on the site.
